title: Splitter proposal
description: Splitter agent's proposed decomposition of an oversized prompt into 2-3 children.

parent_prompt_id.description: The prompt being split, e.g. '16' or '10c'

split_count.description: Number of children — prefer 2 if 2 suffice; 3 max

seam_pattern.description: Which pattern this split uses. Reference the supervised build's three precedents.

slug.description: short descriptive slug for the prompt filename

scope.description: paragraph describing what THIS child ships

not_in_scope.description: paragraph describing what's deferred to a later child

seam_with_next.description: what the next child reads from this one

split_memo_path.description: Path to commit the split memo, e.g. 'docs/06-split-memo-16-bootstrap-wizard.md'

split_memo_content.description: Full memo text, commit-ready, matching the prose format of docs/03-split-memo-10c.md

sequence_updates_needed.description: Almost always true for a split — prompts/PROMPT_SEQUENCE.md needs new rows

sequence_updates_summary.description: What changes in PROMPT_SEQUENCE.md (rows added, dependency-graph updates)

operator_notes.description: Plain-English summary: why this seam, what alternative was considered, what watch-flags carry to children
